classification.difficultyReason: Place north at each departure point and draw the destination ray at the stated clockwise angle, including reflex bearings. This is a direct construction from the taught bearing convention.

content.prompt: Draw a diagram to illustrate the fact that:

answer.worked: $180^{\circ}-160^{\circ}=20^{\circ}$. Draw a north arrow at $O$, then draw $OZ$ clockwise $160^{\circ}$ from north, placing $Z$ southeast of $O$.

spec.description: Completed bearing construction with its north arrow at O.
spec.mathematics: Z has offset proportional to (sin 160°, cos 160°); OZ is 20° east of south.

answer.worked: $360^{\circ}-340^{\circ}=20^{\circ}$. Draw a north arrow at $P$, then draw $PQ$ clockwise $340^{\circ}$ from north, placing $Q$ northwest of $P$.

spec.description: Completed bearing construction with its north arrow at P and a clockwise reflex bearing arc.
spec.mathematics: Q has offset proportional to (sin 340°, cos 340°); PQ is 20° west of north.

children.prompt: to get from $C$ to $D$, you travel on a bearing of $210^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$

answer.worked: $210^{\circ}-180^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$. Draw a north arrow at $C$, then draw $CD$ clockwise $210^{\circ}$ from north, placing $D$ southwest of $C$.

spec.description: Completed bearing construction with its north arrow at C and a clockwise reflex bearing arc.
spec.mathematics: D has offset proportional to (sin 210°, cos 210°); CD is 30° west of south.

children.label: d
children.prompt: to get from $A$ to $Y$, you travel on a bearing of $170^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$

answer.worked: $180^{\circ}-170^{\circ}=10^{\circ}$. Draw a north arrow at $A$, then draw $AY$ clockwise $170^{\circ}$ from north, placing $Y$ southeast of $A$.

spec.description: Completed bearing construction with its north arrow at A.
spec.mathematics: Y has offset proportional to (sin 170°, cos 170°); AY is 10° east of south.
